At Autorola Solutions, we're helping transform how the global automotive industry operates through digital solutions, technology and business process expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Business System Consultant to take a leading role in designing and delivering complex software solutions across customer engagements. Combining strong business process understanding with deep solution expertise, you'll translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality system solutions and take ownership of the technical approach from initial analysis through configuration, implementation and final validation.

As a senior member of the team, you'll be a trusted advisor to customers and an important sparring partner for Project Management Consultants, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries. You'll help shape solution designs, guide technical decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that customer needs are translated into practical, sustainable solutions that create lasting business value.

If you're passionate about solving complex business challenges, advising customers at a strategic and operational level, and driving high-quality software implementations, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us

**The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market. Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

**Lead the design and delivery of smart, scalable solutions

**As Senior Business System Consultant, you'll take ownership of the technical solution throughout the customer engagement. Working in close partnership with a Project Management Consultant, who is responsible for the client relationship, project scope, planning and overall delivery, you'll lead the solution design and ensure that business requirements are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable system solutions.

You'll bring senior-level expertise to complex customer scenarios, advising on business processes, product capabilities and solution alternatives. You'll challenge requirements where appropriate, identify opportunities to leverage standard functionality, and help determine when configuration is sufficient and when further product development is needed.

Your role will extend beyond individual implementations. You'll contribute to improving our solution delivery practices, establish and promote best practices, share knowledge across the team and act as a trusted technical and functional sparring partner for colleagues. Where relevant, you'll also engage directly with customer business teams to ensure that solutions support real operational workflows and deliver the intended business outcomes.

Success means more than delivering a configured system. It means making sound solution decisions, reducing implementation complexity, ensuring consistent quality and helping customers realise lasting value from Autorola's software solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Lead the analysis and translation of complex customer requirements and business processes into effective, scalable solution designs.

• Take ownership of the technical and functional solution approach throughout customer engagements, from initial assessment to implementation and validation.

• Design, configure and build Autorola software solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and align with product capabilities, architecture and standards.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements and recommending solutions that balance business value, feasibility and long-term sustainability.

• Provide senior solution input during project scoping, including technical effort estimates, dependency assessments, risk identification and evaluation of alternative approaches.

• Work closely with Project Management Consultants to ensure that solution decisions support realistic plans, predictable delivery and successful customer outcomes.

• Assess the fit between customer-specific requirements and standard product functionality, identifying when configuration, process adaptation or new development is the most appropriate approach.

• Collaborate with Product Management and Software Development (ASYS) to shape, clarify and qualify enhancement requests and development requirements.

• Take responsibility for solution quality, including configuration standards, test planning, validation and the resolution of functional and technical issues.

• Support customers' operational teams in adopting new solutions and ensuring that implemented functionality works effectively in their day-to-day business.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, solution consistency and reuse through templates, standards, guidelines and proven practices.

• Act as a senior sparring partner and knowledge resource for colleagues, supporting the development of solution expertise and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our consulting methods, delivery processes and collaboration across Business System Consulting, Project Management, Product Management and Software Development.

**Who are we looking for?

**We're looking for an experienced Senior Business System Consultant who combines strong business acumen with substantial solution consulting experience, sound technical judgement and the ability to guide customers and colleagues through complex implementation challenges.

You can move confidently between business processes, product capabilities and technical considerations. You know how to challenge requirements constructively, make informed trade-offs and turn complexity into clear, actionable solution designs.

**You likely have:

**

• Several years of relevant experience in business systems consulting, solution consulting, software implementation, business process consultancy or a similar client-facing role.

• A proven track record of leading or taking significant ownership of complex system implementations and solution designs.

• Strong experience translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable and maintainable software solutions.

• Extensive experience with system configuration, functional design, testing and implementation quality.

• The ability to assess solution alternatives, evaluate technical and functional trade-offs, and make well-founded recommendations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach to decision-making.

• The confidence to advise customers, challenge assumptions and communicate complex topics clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with Project Management, Software Development, Product Management and other cross-functional teams.

• The ability to identify implementation risks, dependencies and opportunities early, helping create more predictable and efficient delivery.

• A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in developing shared standards, best practices and team capabilities.

• The ability to balance individual customer needs with standard functionality, product consistency and long-term maintainability.

• A willingness to travel internationally for customer engagements when required.

Experience with enterprise software, IT consulting, Agile environments or the automotive industry is an advantage. Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to the development of consulting practices is also beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like

**Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established yourself as a trusted senior advisor to customers on complex business processes, solution design and product capabilities.

• Successfully led the solution design and technical delivery of complex customer implementations.

• Built a strong understanding of Autorola's products, business processes, technical capabilities and strategic priorities.

• Helped Project Management Consultants scope customer engagements more accurately through sound technical assessments, effort estimates and early risk identification.

• Improved solution quality, consistency and maintainability through clear design principles and well-founded technical and functional decisions.

• Strengthened collaboration between customers, Business System Consulting, Project Management, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries.

• Contributed to more efficient implementations through reusable solutions, improved templates, standards and best practices.

• Shared your experience and expertise to strengthen the capabilities of the wider consulting team.

• Helped customers adopt their solutions successfully and realise measurable value in their day-to-day operations.

**Why join Autorola Group?

**Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

At Autorola Solutions, you'll join an international environment where project management, business process expertise and software development come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As a Senior Business System Consultant, you'll have a significant influence on how we design and deliver customer solutions. You'll work across organisational and geographical boundaries, collaborate with experienced colleagues and help shape the standards, methods and practices that support our continued growth.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

**Want to join the team?

**We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, at csg@autorola.com.

_Are you driven to transform cancer care by turning science into real-world change? In this role, you will connect cutting-edge evidence with clinical practice, helping physicians make well informed and confident decisions that improve outcomes for people living with cancer and those who care for them. Your work will accelerate the adoption of appropriate therapies by removing diagnostic and pathway bottlenecks through credible, balanced scientific engagement.

_Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

As the therapy-area medical expert for your country, you will lead in-country scientific engagement and execute medical strategy with precision. You will collaborate closely with the Therapeutic Area Lead and country medical leadership, leveraging Nordic alignment to amplify impact. Using digital and AI-enabled tools to strengthen preparation, literature synthesis and insight capture—while upholding scientific integrity and compliance, you will turn external learning into action. Can you see yourself building trusted partnerships that shape launches and elevate standards of care?

This role is field based.

**Accountabilities

**

• Scientific Engagement: Develop and execute the country scientific engagement plan, building trusted relationships with experts, societies, investigators and healthcare stakeholders.

• Scientific Exchange: Lead balanced, non-promotional scientific dialogue, respond compliantly to unsolicited requests and manage advisory boards in line with procedures.

• Insight Generation: Identify pathway bottlenecks, diagnostic gaps and adoption barriers; translate insights into recommendations for strategy, evidence generation, launches and access.

• Launch & Transforming Care: Support launch readiness, medical education, scientific narrative development, objection handling and initiatives that address healthcare-system needs.

• Evidence & Clinical Trials: Identify local evidence gaps, support RWE and externally sponsored research, and contribute to clinical-trial feasibility, site engagement and delivery.

• Market Access Support: Provide scientific input to HTA, formulary and protocol submissions, guidelines and appropriate-use initiatives.

• Governance & Internal Enablement: Ensure compliance with local codes, SOPs and ethical standards; support medical review, pharmacovigilance and inspection readiness.

• Medical Expertise & Collaboration: Act as a therapy-area subject-matter expert, deliver scientific training and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and Nordic teams.

**Essential Skills And Experience

**

• Advanced life-sciences degree, such as MSc, PharmD, MD or PhD.

• Proven deliverables for the experience in the relevant therapy area and scientific stakeholder engagement.

• Strong ability to generate insights, synthesize evidence and translate findings into action.

• Understanding of clinical trials, evidence generation and medical support for market access.

• Excellent scientific communication, influencing and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to use digital and AI-enabled tools with scientific rigor, compliance and sound judgment.

• Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based position.

• Fluency in the local language and English.

**Desirable Skills And Experience

**

• PhD, MD, MBA or other relevant advanced qualifications.

• Proven successful pharmaceutical Medical Affairs experience, particularly in pre-launch or launch environments.

• Proven impactful collaborations in clinical trials, RWE or externally sponsored research.

• Experience supporting HTA, formulary or protocol submissions.

• Eligibility for local material certification.

• Proficiency with analytics, insight platforms and relevant management systems.

**We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

**Join a team where science and strategy come together to change how cancer is treated. You will collaborate closely with clinicians, biostatisticians, data scientists, market access experts and more—often in the same room—turning evidence into practice that improves every step of the patient journey. We empower bold ideas, learn fast from what works, and back ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards. With a strong and diverse oncology pipeline, opportunities to shape real-world evidence, and a culture of openness and learning, your expertise will directly influence clinical decisions and accelerate meaningful progress for patients, science and society.

jobs.description:
The overall purpose of Danish Red Cross’ (DRC) international engagement is to increase and strengthen humanitarian impact, inspire and act for human dignity, and enhance resilience and social cohesion in contexts of poverty, conflict and disaster.

The Global Partnership unit leads the coordination and strategic direction of the Danish Red Cross’ international partnerships, external and within the Red Cross and Red Crescent movement. The Unit is responsible for global resource mobilization efforts and initiatives and provides support to countries and regions. The Unit hosts the Danish Red Cross’ core donor specialization knowledge and capacity on compliance and strategies. Furthermore, the unit supports and quality assures proposals to core donors.

The position

As part of the Movement relations and private partnerships team (MOPS), the Partnership Advisor will drive Danish Red Cross’ strategic engagement with Danish and international foundations and private sector actors, with the objective of growing and diversifying non-institutional funding and strategic partnerships. The role combines new partnership development with strategic management and growth of high-value, multi-year partnerships. It focuses on senior-level relationship building, development of innovative partnership models, negotiation of multi-year agreements, and strong partnership stewardship across the full lifecycle. The Advisor will position DRC as a preferred humanitarian partner among Danish businesses, corporate foundations, family foundations, and selected international private sector actors through collaboration within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

Main responsibilities:

• Develop and implement a multi-year strategy for Danish and international private sector and foundation engagement aligned with DRC’s international priorities.

• Build and convert a qualified pipeline of high-value partnership opportunities, with clear income and partnership-growth ambitions.

• Lead the strategic management of one or more high-value, multi-year foundation partnerships, including relationship management, governance, internal coordination, delivery oversight and identification of opportunities for growth.

• Ensure strong partnership stewardship throughout the grant lifecycle, working closely with programme, finance and operational colleagues to support delivery, reporting, compliance and proactive management of risks and partner expectations.

• Develop partnership models beyond traditional grant funding, including strategic co-creation and multi-stakeholder alliances.

• Support country and regional teams to identify, shape and pursue high-potential private sector and foundation partnerships.

• Work closely with Business Development Advisors, Fundraising, and Operations to align private sector engagement with programming priorities.

• Represent DRC in relevant private sector and foundation networks and relevant Movement platforms related to private sector engagement.

We expect you to have the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree or MBA in Business, International Affairs, International Development or related

• Significant experience (7-10 years) in business development, resource mobilization, partnership development, preferably in the humanitarian or non-profit sector

• Demonstrated success in securing high-value, multi-year private sector or foundation partnerships

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, high-value, multi-year and/or multi-stakeholder partnerships including stakeholder engagement, negotiation, renewal and growth

• Strong established network in Denmark and ideally internationally

• Solid understanding of private sector CSR strategies, corporate foundations, and philanthropic trends

• Strong strategic account-management skills, including experience balancing partner expectations with organisational priorities and operational realities

• Experience coordinating complex partnerships across multiple internal teams, technical areas and geographies

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, Danish is an advantage

As a person you have the following competences:

• High level of strategic thinking and diplomatic and political judgement

• Ability to lead processes and engage people across functions and geographies

• Results-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset and ability to turn opportunities into concrete action.

• Collaborative team player with the ability to build trust and work in a multicultural environment

We offer

A full-time position of 37 working hours per week in an inspiring workplace. You will have the opportunity to work in a diversified motivated team of donor experts and be part of Danish Red Cross’ large global humanitarian action. You will refer to the Head of Global Partnership in Copenhagen.

The position is based in Copenhagen with potential 4-8-week travel. Salary and employment conditions will comply with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargain agreement with AC.

Application and further information

We look forward to receiving your application via the Red Cross home page www.rodekors.dk/job

In case you have questions to the position please contact Head of Global Partnerships, Marie-Chantal Legendre Dahl mcd@rodekors.dk or Team coordinator Vivian Pucher vipuc@rodekors.dk

Application deadline is 20th November 2026; Interviews will take place soon thereafter. The expected date of commencement is as soon as possible, preferably no later than January 1st.

_

Red Cross

Join us. Together we can make a world of difference. The Red Cross is always present. We are the largest humanitarian organisation in the world and for 150 years we have helped alleviate people through wars and disasters, diseases and loneliness. Most countries have signed an agreement which gives the Red Cross Red Crescent Movement a unique position and mandate to provide aid regardless of nationality, race or political views. We currently count 11 million volunteers in 191 countries. We are part of your local community no matter where you live. When disaster strikes, we are there._

Be part of a dynamic and fast-paced International Secretariat - while gaining knowledge of the Danish Red Cross’ international humanitarian work.

Are you interested in international humanitarian work as well as management support and strategic organisational processes? Do you bring experience from an organisation with international engagements? Do you have strong organisational and communication skills? And do you have experience with coordinating meetings and events in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment? Then you might be our new student assistant in the International Secretariat at the Danish Red Cross Headquarters in Copenhagen.

The Danish Red Cross’ International Department supports and cooperates with national societies in countries in Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. As a student assistant in the International Secretariat, you will be part of a dynamic and fast-paced team in the International Department. The primary function of the International Secretariat is to support the International Director and Management Group in lifting strategic and key cross-cutting areas for the benefit of the International Department as well as the Danish Red Cross as a whole. It provides the best possible support to the International Director and Management Group and ensures a well-functioning governance structure and smooth day-to-day running of the International Department.

As a student assistant in the International Secretariat, you will primarily assist and report to the Senior Executive Secretary and the Management Advisor. At the same time, you will join a team of 11 student assistants in the International Department (3 in the International Secretariat) providing support across 5 units in the International Department, when needed, i.e. Global Partnerships, Operations, Humanitarian Policy & Analysis, Technical Quality & Impact, and Disaster & Crisis Response. This position thus offers you the opportunity to gain extensive experience in various areas of responsibility across the International Department.

Your assignments

The assignments that the student assistant will be responsible for in the International Secretariat are wide-ranging and will for instance include:

• Assisting the International Secretariat with various tasks relating to the planning, implementation, and follow-up on strategic organisational processes in the International Department

• Assisting with internal communication, including maintaining the International Department’s intranet in English, proofreading documents and drafting PowerPoint presentations in English and Danish, and ensuring the layout of various types of documents

• Assisting with the planning and coordination of high-level meetings and large-scale events in the International Department, including the technical set-up (Teams), meeting files, PowerPoint presentations, minutes, practicalities, and follow-up

• Assisting with research and analysis for different target groups

• Assisting with the daily maintenance of the International Department’s office space and contributing to a nice working environment.

Your profile

• You work independently and proactively, but you are also an active team player. You are always ready to chip in and help with any task that is needed – from the mundane to the novel – that working in a dynamic and fast-paced International Secretariat requires.

• You have excellent communication skills in English and Danish (written and verbal), preferably with a proven record of communication to various target groups. You are also familiar with Teams platforms and other digital communication tools – and you are ready to dive into new communication tools if needed.

• You can give concrete examples of your organizational skills and experience, perhaps in relation to meetings/events, and preferably from other student jobs or voluntary work where your contributions made a real difference.

• As you will work in an ever-changing environment that demands high accuracy, you must be well-structured, thorough, reliable, punctual, and flexible.

• With a curious mindset and a drive for new challenges, you also proactively suggest improvements both within and beyond your own responsibilities.

• Preferably, you have knowledge of international development and humanitarian work and possibly also (volunteer) experience from an NGO.

• We expect you to be enrolled at university, doing an academic degree in e.g. social or political science, development studies or similar, preferably having completed your 4th semester and with at least one year of studies remaining.

We offer

You will get the chance to gain first-hand experience of what it is like to work in the International Secretariat that supports the International Director and International Management Group. You will learn about the Danish Red Cross’ international humanitarian work, have highly varied areas of responsibility and receive ongoing supervision and support by your colleagues in the International Secretariat, who value a good and positive team culture while we move at a fast pace.

At the same time, you will get the opportunity to apply what you have learned during your academic program in a challenging, yet meaningful setting. Finally, you will be part of a community of students who collaborate, share knowledge and support one another whenever needed.

The student assistant position in the International Secretariat is vacant from medio January 2027. The weekly hours are 15, and the payment is according to the collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a motivational letter (both in English) by 19 November. Please note that only applications forwarded via the link on the Danish Red Cross web site will be taken into account. The interviews are expected to take place on 24 and 25 November.

If you wish to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Senior Executive Secretary, Maibritt Damgaard Nielsen at manie@rodekors.dk .

**Job Description

**Open Banking is reshaping how customers connect with their banks, and Danske Bank is at the centre of that shift. As a Product Owner in the Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe, you will help define how businesses and developers integrate with us through regulatory and premium APIs. You will gain real ownership over a product that sits at the heart of our Forward 28 strategy.

**What You Will Be Doing

**The Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe is a team of around 150 colleagues spread across the Nordics, Lithuania, and India, working to automate and streamline financial interactions between customers, Danske Bank, the financial sector, and authorities. You will work closely with your squad and a wide range of stakeholders to shape an Open Banking platform that is available, scalable, stable, and resilient. The work is genuinely complex, and the decisions you make will shape how the next generation of integrations, whether direct, via third parties, or via AI, come to life.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Translating vision and strategy into clear backlog priorities and roadmaps

• Turning customer needs, business objectives, and technical possibilities into tangible increments

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation

• Creating a collaborative and supportive environment where your squad can do their best work

• Identifying opportunities to apply AI to improve both the product and ways of working

**About You

**

• Five or more years of experience in product development, including a leadership dimension

• Ability to make complex topics clear and actionable for different audiences

• Strong interpersonal skills and a natural collaborator

• Commercial mindset with the ability to connect customer needs to business value

• Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations

• Experience working with AI tools or applying AI thinking in practice

Experience from financial services or a regulated industry would be a welcome addition. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh perspective from adjacent sectors.

jobs.occupation: Entry IT Specialist, Power BI & Data Engineering - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by turning data into reliable insights and practical solutions for commercial teams?

Do you enjoy combining Power BI development with hands-on support and a growing understanding of Azure data engineering?

Join our Retail Product Team in Commercial IT & Digital and help develop, operate and improve data and reporting solutions used across Arla’s commercial organization. Our portfolio supports areas such as Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

You will work with Power BI solutions built on commercial datasets covering areas such as electronic point-of-sale data, sales, products and customers. You will also build your understanding of the Azure-based data pipelines and data products that provide the foundation for these insights.

How You Will Make An Impact

As our Entry IT Specialist within Retail, your initial focus will be developing, maintaining and supporting Power BI reports and dashboards. Alongside this, you will gradually contribute to selected data engineering activities and strengthen your understanding of the end-to-end data flow from source systems and Azure pipelines to business-facing reporting.

This is a varied and operational role. Your work will shift between development, troubleshooting, incident response, user support and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Architects and other IT colleagues, with support and guidance matched to your experience.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

• Develop, enhance and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models based on business needs.

• Work with Power BI Desktop, Power Query, DAX and SQL to create clear, reliable and user-friendly reporting solutions.

• Support existing Power BI solutions, including investigating incidents, troubleshooting data issues and communicating progress to users and stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, clarify requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.

• Contribute to data quality checks, testing, documentation, deployment and structured handover of new or changed solutions.

• Understand and monitor the upstream data flows that supply Power BI solutions, and help identify whether issues originate in the report, data model or data pipeline.

• Contribute to selected Azure data engineering tasks, such as data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and pipeline maintenance, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, code reviews and continuous improvement activities across the Retail Product Team.

• Help improve operational stability through better monitoring, documentation, reusable solutions and root-cause resolution.

What Will Make You Successful

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. More important than knowing every technology from day one is that you have a solid analytical foundation, enjoy solving real operational problems and are motivated to develop across both business intelligence and data engineering.

We Imagine That You Bring

• A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Practical knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modelling and basic DAX. This may come from work, an internship, studies or personal projects.

• Working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of relational data, data quality and analytical modelling.

• An interest in Azure data platforms and a desire to learn technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake and Databricks.

• Basic programming experience, preferably with Python or PySpark, is an advantage.

• An understanding of ETL/ELT, data pipelines, Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD or automated testing is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• The ability to communicate clearly in English and collaborate with both technical colleagues and business stakeholders.

Most importantly, you are curious, structured and hands-on. You take responsibility for following tasks through, are comfortable asking for support when needed and enjoy a role where priorities can move between planned development and urgent operational needs. You are motivated by learning, but also by making existing solutions work reliably for their users.

What do we offer?

You will join a collaborative Retail Product Team with a broad commercial solution landscape and strong opportunities to learn across reporting, data engineering and product operations. You will gain practical experience with business-critical data and solutions while working closely with experienced specialists, architects and commercial stakeholders.

• A role with Power BI as the initial focus and a clear opportunity to build capabilities in Azure data engineering over time.

• Varied work across development, support, incident handling and continuous improvement rather than a narrow single-technology role.

• Structured onboarding, professional guidance and room to take increasing ownership as your experience grows.

• Exposure to commercial processes and solutions within Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

• An international and collaborative working environment with flexibility and opportunities for professional development.

Would you like to join us?

If you are motivated by combining data, reporting and technology, and want to grow into a versatile specialist who can develop solutions and support them in daily operation, we would like to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.
